mask_roms.source: tools/fetch-rom-elfs.sh roms (espressif/esp-rom-elfs, pinned by SHA-256 in the script)

firmware.build: arduino-cli 1.5.1, Arduino-ESP32 core 3.3.12 (ESP-IDF v5.5.5); the core's WiFi and HTTPClient libraries
firmware.fqbn: esp32:esp32:esp32s3 (default options: 4 MB quad flash, DIO)

bootloader.bin.note: the core's default S3 bootloader, 4 MB flash header

firmware.not_committed: A plain Arduino build of the sketch; not added to the repository.

runs.wifi-net: esp32sim --rom roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf --boot rom --board none --flash-mb 4 --bootloader bootloader.bin --ptable partitions.bin --app wifi-net.bin --wifi ssid=Jumperly --net nat --console uart0 --debug net --max-seconds 40 --no-dump
runs.note: The same command on main 9890ac55 and on this branch, on a desktop with internet access: the NAT relays the guest's DNS, SNTP and HTTP to the real network through StdTransport (the host resolver falls back to 1.1.1.1 where there is no /etc/resolv.conf). Host addresses and ports in the NAT log are replaced by <host>:<port> in the receipt.
